about_mission: ACS Mulingua has embarked in the mission of enabling people to communicate effectively and confidently in different languages, empowering them to succeed in an increasingly internationalized world while protecting and developing their local and regional languages. Multilingualism, as a social and cultural concept has the potential to do this. It can stop linguicide and linguicism while promoting international languages together with local and regional languages. Our mission aims also at instilling hope, advancing equity, and catalyzing achievement in communities and educational institutions. We do this by providing encouraging and empowering courses to community leaders, workers and students of all ages who are committed to education.
about_mission2: We aim to foster a community of language learners and promote cross-cultural understanding and collaboration.
about_story: ACS Mulingua is an academia that operates under the aegis of Asociacion Ccahuac solidarity (ACS). ACS is a non-profit organization, founded in 2010 by a small group of people in Lima, Peru to act on the serious problem of poverty and environmental degradation. ACS is presently promoting a project to make people become self-  sufficient in food production and to raise consciousness on global warming and food insecurity. We have always believed that education is the essential tool that can transform communities and remove them from the hardship of destitution. ACS Mulingua falls within these initiatives with a broader objective of reaching communities around the world.
about_vision: Our vision is to be a leading provider of online multilingual education, enabling individuals and organizations around the world to achieve their language and educational goals. We envision a world where individuals can communicate fluently in different languages, breaking down cultural barriers and fostering mutual understanding and respect. Our goal is to make language education accessible to everyone, regardless of location or background, and to leverage technology to enhance the language learning experience. We recognize the diversity of learners and their cultural backgrounds and embrace teaching practices rooted in local cultures and languages.
about_tutors: Our tutors are experienced professionals who are committed to their duties and the law of ethics enunciated in the Teacher´s Charter and are mostly multi or bilinguals. Furthermore, they are engaged in permanent training and lifelong learning which is broadly defined as the ongoing, voluntary, self-motivated pursuit of knowledge. The teachers are valued and are the ones who head this project both in its management and implementation.
